summary: Phase4 is implemented across the bridge API, provider settings UI, tests, and packaged web assets.
features_completed: Compact /providers response with models=[] by default and model_count metadata
New dependency-free ModelSelect component with substring fuzzy search and keyboard navigation
Quick connect, active model, and advanced default model inputs now use ModelSelect
Provider models lazy-load through getProviderModels(providerId) and cache in memory for the modal lifetime
Lazy-load failure warnings allow manual model ID input
Advanced model chips are limited to 10 by default with more/collapse controls and bounded scrolling
Production frontend assets rebuilt into appforge/resources/web
decisions: Applied Phase4 F-1 A: remove /providers/models and keep /providers/{id}/models as SSOT.
Applied Phase4 F-2 A: use component-local memory cache, not localStorage.
Kept ModelSelect input enabled during loading/failure so manual model IDs remain possible.
Used provider expansion to trigger advanced-row lazy loading so model chips can populate before explicit typing.
known_gaps: No live third-party model request was run because it requires user credentials.
No browser screenshot automation was run; production build and smoke verified the served packaged UI.
